title: play --link options: help, bad values and score mistakes reported with where they are
description:
As a performer, I want every mistake on the command line or in the score reported with where it is, so that I can fix it before the set.

Spec file: `features/link/play.feature`.

```gherkin
Feature: Link options on the command line

  Scenario: Help lists the Link options
    When I run "apricity play --help"
    Then it describes --link, --quantum, --no-start-stop and --latency, one line each

  Scenario Outline: Bad values are refused before joining
    When I run "apricity play click.apr <args>"
    Then it exits with status 2
    And it prints "<message>"
    And no Link session was joined

    Examples:
      | args                          | message                                                           |
      | --link --quantum 0            | --quantum: a whole number of beats from 1 to 16 (got 0)           |
      | --link --quantum 2.5          | --quantum: a whole number of beats from 1 to 16 (got 2.5)         |
      | --quantum 4                   | --quantum needs --link                                             |
      | --no-start-stop               | --no-start-stop needs --link                                       |
      | --link --latency 900          | --latency: between -500 and 500 ms (got 900)                       |

  Scenario: A score with mistakes never joins
    When I run "apricity play bad.apr --link" for a score with a mistake on line 3, column 7
    Then it prints the problem as "bad.apr: line 3 column 7: …", as `apricity play` does today
    And it exits with status 1 without joining a Link session

  Scenario: A broken save while linked
    Given the score plays in a Link session
    When I save it with a mistake on line 5
    Then it prints the problem as "<score>: line 5 column <n>: …"
    And the last good version keeps playing on the session's beat
```
